Usage: astryx theme template [options] [path]

Write the annotated theme template into your project

Options:
  -f, --overwrite  Replace an existing file
  -h, --help       display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success, including when an existing file was left untouched
  1  the target path escapes the project, or the file cannot be written

Examples:
  # Write it at the project root
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme template
  # Somewhere else
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme template src/themes/starter.ts

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-template
